h1: Custom Kraft Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom kraft koozies for your next event. Eco-friendly, bulk pricing, fast turnaround. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kraft koozies offer a natural, eco-friendly look that stands out from standard foam or neoprene options. Made from recycled paperboard, they provide a rustic canvas for screen-printed logos, perfect for brewery events, outdoor promotions, or any brand that values sustainability. The Fiesta Kit style combines a kraft koozie with a bottle opener for added utility. These koozies are lightweight, affordable, and fully customizable with your imprint.
heroAltText: Custom kraft koozies with screen-printed logo, eco-friendly paperboard material
